verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents an official CDP CLI. It installs as an AI skill, configures API keys, can be used to run treasury and payout workflows, and includes `cdp mcp`, which exposes every API endpoint as a tool. A separate official Agentic Wallet CLI gives AI agents wallet, send, trade and x402 payment skills, with spending limits and flags such as `--max-amount`. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's behavior beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CDP CLI includes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool.
Installs the CDP CLI and configures API key + wallet secret from the Coinbase Developer Portal. Verifies connectivity.
Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
Agentic Wallet CLI gives any AI agent a standalone wallet to hold and spend stablecoins, or trade for other tokens on Base.
Spending limits | Configurable caps per session and per transaction
